title: puremacro: Production-grade Macroeconometric and Heterogeneous-Agent Structural Modeling in Pure Python
description: puremacro is a self-contained, zero-C-extension macroeconomic computing library built in pure Python and NumPy. It unifies structural models, high-dimensional econometrics, mixed-frequency nowcasting, penalized forecasting, and climate-macro integration, portable to web browsers via Pyodide.
